messages:
Alex S.: Hey team — kicking off AcmeCorp POC onboarding. They want a minimal access plan so they can validate integrations: hosted API keys for dev, ingest telemetry/audit logs into their monitoring (Splunk/S3), and an estimate for a Dedicated pool if they scale. Also attached a short security questionnaire. What's the fastest path for POC (least friction) and what formal artifacts do we need to provide?

Ben (AcmeCorp): Hi! For the POC we need: 1) scoped API key for our engineers 2) audit events (who/when/endpoint/model/tokens) exported to our S3 or Splunk HEC, retention 12 months 3) KMS-wrapped logs preferred 4) rough cost for 1-2 GPU nodes. NDA in place. Timeline: start next week.

Emma (Security): Quick checklist: for POC we can offer hosted API keys scoped to the customer workspace and token-rotate guidance. Audit exports: we support delivery to customer-owned S3 buckets (preferred) or forwarding to Splunk HEC via our connector. Requirements: customer AWS account ID, destination bucket ARN, KMS CMK ARN (or we can use our KMS if customer requests). We need to confirm whether prompts can be included unredacted — default is to redact PII; for security review we'll provide examples of the audit schema and a redaction policy doc.

Derek - Infra: For Dedicated sizing: if their traffic is <=100 req/s with typical gen lengths (~256 tokens) a single T4/A10-equivalent pool with 2 replicas should be fine for POC. Estimates: ~$6k-$9k/mo depending on region and preemptibility. If they need lower latency/better concurrency, bump to 4x. For pricing I'll ping finance for an exact quote.

Lina (SRE): Timeline notes: hosted API key + S3 export can be set up in 1-2 business days once we have bucket ARN + KMS + consent to deliver logs. Private/VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC) is a 2-3 week setup (networking, peering, IAM). Dedicated pool provisioning is 3-5 days once contract signed and capacity reserved.

Alex S.: Emma — what artifacts do we hand to the customer for their security questionnaire? They asked for "evidence" on logging, access controls, and key management.

Emma (Security): Provideable artifacts for POC: - Audit schema sample (JSON) showing fields: request_id, timestamp, principal, endpoint, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, status - Link to our logging export docs (S3 + HEC) - Statement of redaction policy + opt-in guidance for full prompts under NDA - Screenshot of console IAM/policy UI showing scoped API key permissions - Copy of our SOC2 Type II summary (not full report) and contact for detailed compliance pack (available on request under an MSA).

Derek - Infra: Example S3 export API to kick off (replace placeholders):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/log-exports \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{\"customer_id\":\"acmecorp\",\"dest\":{\"type\":\"s3\",\"bucket_arn\":\"arn:aws:s3:::acmecorp-redwood-logs\",\"kms_key_arn\":\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abc-123\"},\"format\":\"jsonl\",\"retention_days\":365}'
```
Note: we cannot write into customer buckets without a bucket policy grant; they must create bucket and add our principal. We'll provide a sample bucket policy.

Ben (AcmeCorp): That curl helps. Can you share the sample bucket policy and Splunk HEC config? Also, will logs include prompt text by default? Our security team insists on redaction unless explicitly allowed.

Emma (Security): Default: prompts are redacted at rest. For POC we can enable full prompt export to customer bucket under NDA and with explicit change request. We will log the change and require a ticket. I'll attach the redaction policy and a short checklist for approving prompt exports.

Lina (SRE): Sample bucket policy we'll send: grant PutObject to our service principal and restrict by prefix. For Splunk, we have a connector that posts to HEC with HMAC; need HEC endpoint and token. We'll run a short smoke test once they set HEC endpoint/credentials.

Alex S.: Action items: 1) Emma to share security artifacts and redaction policy PDF 2) Derek to draft quick Dedicated pool estimate and sample S3 policy 3) Lina to provide Splunk HEC connector doc and smoke test steps 4) Ben to share bucket ARN, KMS key or HEC endpoint + timeline. I'll coordinate and aim to have hosted key + S3 export working by Wed.

Emma (Security): Ack — I'll drop the redaction policy and audit-schema.json in this thread by EOD.

Derek - Infra: Finance pinged back: provisional dedicated POC pricing 1x A10-equivalent reserved -> $7,250/mo, includes basic support and 4TB egress cap for POC. I'll convert to formal quote once Alex confirms customer region.

deploy-bot: New support ticket created #POC-4398 for AcmeCorp log export setup (owner: Lina (SRE)).

Ben (AcmeCorp): Great, thanks. Sending over bucket ARN + KMS in an encrypted email. We'll hold off on prompt export for now until legal signs NDA.

Alex S.: Perfect. I'll follow up tomorrow with a short timeline and calendar for the smoke test. Thanks all :thumbsup:
